model_sql.first_order_per_member: select member_id, order_id, ordered_at as first_ordered_at, paid_cents - refund_cents as first_net_cents from (select *, row_number() over (partition by member_id order by ordered_at, order_id) as rn from {{ ref('orders') }} where status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) t where rn = 1
model_sql.repeat_valid_orders: select order_id, member_id, ordered_at from (select order_id, member_id, ordered_at, row_number() over (partition by member_id order by ordered_at, order_id) as rn from {{ ref('orders') }} where status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) t where rn >= 2
model_sql.member_month_valid_orders: select member_id || '-' || strftime(month_start, '%Y-%m') as member_month, member_id, month_start, count(*) as valid_order_cnt, sum(paid_cents - refund_cents) as net_cents from (select member_id, date_trunc('month', ordered_at) as month_start, paid_cents, refund_cents from {{ ref('orders') }} where status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) t group by member_id, month_start
model_sql.paid_member_month: select m.member_month, m.member_id, m.month_start, m.valid_order_cnt, m.net_cents from {{ ref('member_month_valid_orders') }} m where exists (select 1 from {{ ref('cards') }} c where c.member_id = m.member_id and c.card_type in ('悦享年卡','家庭季卡') and c.valid_from <= last_day(m.month_start) and c.valid_until > last_day(m.month_start) and (c.ended_at is null or c.ended_at > last_day(m.month_start)))

business_model_usage.quote: 付费会员只算悦享年卡和家庭季卡的持有人；异业联名卡虽收费但由合作方经营、不进自营会员范围，体验卡不算；该定义只约束本期月报
按自然月最后一天判断资格，先选月末有资格的账户，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单，不要求每笔订单发生当天已具备资格
门店判断资格按账户看、不按卡张数；账户可无卡或持多张卡，只要有一张卡在判定日有效且属本次业务范围，该账户即有资格，多张有效卡不重复算人
卡从生效日期当天起有效，到有效期结束日期当天已无效（不含结束日），有提前终止日期的从提前终止当天起无效；须对判定日核对，不能只看当前状态
老周确认测试库账户与卡一对多
